services_heading: Interior and Exterior Decorating Services Across Birmingham
services_subhead: From a single bedroom refresh to full property decoration, we handle every job with care and precision.

services.title: Interior Painting
services.desc: Walls, ceilings, woodwork, and feature walls painted flawlessly. We protect your furniture, clean up fully, and leave you with a pristine finish.

services.title: Exterior Painting and Rendering
services.desc: Weatherproof exterior finishes that protect your home and look immaculate. We handle fascias, soffits, doors, and rendered surfaces.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging and Removal
services.desc: Precise wallpaper installation on feature walls or whole rooms. We also strip and prepare walls for new decoration.

services.title: Kitchen and Bathroom Decoration
services.desc: Moisture-resistant paint finishes perfect for kitchens and bathrooms. We ensure durability in wet environments and quality sealant work.

services.title: Woodwork and Skirting Preparation
services.desc: Expert preparation, undercoating, and finishing of doors, skirting, architrave, and window frames for a professional appearance.

services.title: Landlord and Commercial Decoration
services.desc: Efficient turnaround for rental properties and commercial spaces. We work flexibly to minimise disruption and meet your letting schedule.

about_pullquote: We treat every home as if it were our own, and every customer like a neighbour.
about_para_1: AA Local First Class Decorator was founded in 2004 with a simple idea: bring honest, skilled decorating to Birmingham families without the fuss or inflated bills. Over two decades, we've painted and decorated thousands of homes across Birmingham and the surrounding areas, building a reputation for reliability, attention to detail, and friendly service. We're still a small, local operation — no call centres or franchises, just experienced decorators who turn up on time and do the job right.
about_para_2: Our customers come back to us because we listen, we deliver, and we don't overcomplicate things. Whether it's a quick refresh or a complete redecoration, we take pride in leaving your home looking fresh and well-protected. Many of our jobs come from referrals and repeat business — a testament to the trust Birmingham families place in us.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Absolutely brilliant. Had our lounge and hallway decorated and it looks stunning. The lads were polite, tidy, and worked really efficiently. They even repaired a bit of damaged plaster without making a fuss about it. Wouldn't hesitate to recommend them.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: First time using AA Local and I'm genuinely impressed. Free quote came through next day, pricing was fair and transparent, no hidden extras. The decorator arrived on time, protected everything properly, and the finish is immaculate. Will definitely use them again when we do the bedrooms.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Came to us on recommendation from a neighbour and so glad they did. Needed our kitchen repainted with moisture-resistant finish and they explained exactly what they'd do and why. Work quality is professional, and the chap was friendly and chatty. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: Paul H.
